text:
jess: heads-up: customer saw duplicate provisional tokens after a streaming resume. looks like snapshot merge + route fallback raced. cc @nate

nate: any logs? which pools?

jess: snippet:
```
INFO session=xyz789 resume snapshot=SNAP-88 ttl_expired=true route=hot-pool fallback=cold-pool provisional=32
INFO ledger write provisional session=xyz789 tokens=32 origin=resume
INFO ledger write provisional session=xyz789 tokens=32 origin=fallback
```

karen: two writes in same second. dedupe should prevent this. probable cause: derived session id differs per-pool due to HMAC key mismatch.

sam: yep — per-pool HMAC rotation bug causes non-canonical ids until later reconciliation, so ledger dedupe misses.

nate: short-term fix: add idempotency at ledger.write keyed by canonical_session_id when available; if canonical absent, fallback to best-effort HMAC and emit metric "provisional.dedupe.miss".

karen: console: flag "resume-hysteresis-collision" on session timeline and show count on route dashboard. also link provisional_id -> refunds so cost waterfall collapses duplicates.

sam: rollout: put idempotency + metric behind kill-switch, canary to 3 pools for 48h, then global. ops-bot: schedule migration to merge provisional dupes for last 7 days (dry-run first).

ops-bot: queued job merge-provisional-hysteresis-collisions v1 (2026-03-15..2026-03-22) dry-run estimate ~8k rows

jess: action items: karen PR for console + metric; sam PR for ledger idempotency and canonicalization; nate coordinate canary; ops-bot run dry-run. low-severity but visible to customers. :thumbsup:
